name: 肿瘤免疫与微环境预设
description: 专注于免疫细胞亚群、肿瘤免疫微环境(TME)、免疫检查点受体配体与细胞因子通信网络的分类体系。
en_description: Ontology dedicated to immune cell subsets, tumor microenvironment (TME), checkpoints, and cytokine communication.

Immune_Cell_Subset.name: 免疫细胞亚群
Immune_Cell_Subset.label: 免疫细胞亚群
Immune_Cell_Subset.description: T细胞、B细胞、NK细胞、巨噬细胞、树突状细胞等功能亚群
Immune_Cell_Subset.en_description: T cells, B cells, NK cells, macrophages, dendritic cells, and functional subsets.
patterns: .*(?:淋巴细胞|单核细胞|巨噬细胞|中性粒细胞|树突状细胞|t细胞|b细胞)$

^(?:t cell|cd4\+ t cell|cd8\+ t cell|cytotoxic t cell|helper t cell|th1|th2|th17|regulatory t cell|treg|b cell|plasma cell|natural killer cell|nk cell|macrophage|m1 macrophage|m2 macrophage|tam|dendritic cell|dc|neutrophil|myeloid-derived suppressor cell|mdsc)$

Tumor_Stroma_Cell.name: 肿瘤细胞 / 基质细胞
Tumor_Stroma_Cell.label: 肿瘤细胞 / 基质细胞
Tumor_Stroma_Cell.description: 恶性肿瘤细胞、肿瘤相关成纤维细胞(CAF)、内皮细胞或周细胞
Tumor_Stroma_Cell.en_description: Malignant tumor cells, CAFs, endothelial cells, or pericytes in the TME.
patterns: .*(?:肿瘤细胞|癌细胞|基质细胞|内皮细胞|成纤维细胞)$
^(?:tumor cell|cancer cell|malignant cell|cancer-associated fibroblast|caf|endothelial cell|pericyte|tumor stroma|extracellular matrix|hela|jurkat|mcf-7|a549|hepg2)$

Immune_Checkpoint.name: 免疫检查点受体 / 配体
Immune_Checkpoint.label: 免疫检查点受体 / 配体
Immune_Checkpoint.description: 调控免疫耐受或介导免疫逃逸的共刺激/共抑制跨膜分子
Immune_Checkpoint.en_description: Costimulatory or coinhibitory transmembrane molecules mediating tolerance or escape.

Cytokine_Chemokine.name: 细胞因子 / 趋化因子
Cytokine_Chemokine.label: 细胞因子 / 趋化因子
Cytokine_Chemokine.description: 介导细胞间通信与免疫细胞趋化招募的可溶性细胞因子
Cytokine_Chemokine.en_description: Intercellular communication cytokines, interleukins, interferons, or chemokines.
patterns: .*(?:细胞因子|趋化因子|白介素|干扰素)$

Metabolic_Soluble_Factor.name: 微环境代谢物 / 胞外成分
Metabolic_Soluble_Factor.label: 微环境代谢物 / 胞外成分
Metabolic_Soluble_Factor.description: 乳酸、腺苷等免疫抑制性代谢物或细胞外基质胶原成分
Metabolic_Soluble_Factor.en_description: Immunosuppressive metabolites, extracellular matrix (ECM) components, or hypoxia mediators.
patterns: .*(?:代谢物|微环境因子|基质胶原)$

Immune_Phenotype_Pathway.name: 免疫表型 / 效应反应
Immune_Phenotype_Pathway.label: 免疫表型 / 效应反应
Immune_Phenotype_Pathway.description: 抗原呈递、T细胞耗竭、免疫逃逸或细胞毒性杀伤等过程
Immune_Phenotype_Pathway.en_description: Antigen presentation, T cell exhaustion, immune evasion, or cytotoxic killing.
patterns: ^(?:immune evasion|immune escape|t cell exhaustion|antigen presentation|cytotoxic killing|cytokine storm|crs|cold tumor|hot tumor|immunosuppression)$

Uncertain.name: 无法判断 / 未定
Uncertain.label: 无法判断 / 未定
Uncertain.description: 无法归类或证据不足的免疫微环境实体概念

Checkpoint_Engagement_Exhaustion.name: 检查点结合 / 免疫耗竭诱导
Checkpoint_Engagement_Exhaustion.label: 检查点结合 / 免疫耗竭诱导
Checkpoint_Engagement_Exhaustion.description: PD-1/PD-L1等分子结合介导T细胞受体信号抑制与耗竭
Checkpoint_Engagement_Exhaustion.en_description: Checkpoint receptor-ligand interaction inducing T cell functional exhaustion.

Cytotoxic_Killing_Lysis.name: 细胞毒性杀伤 / 溶瘤清除
Cytotoxic_Killing_Lysis.label: 细胞毒性杀伤 / 溶瘤清除
Cytotoxic_Killing_Lysis.description: 效应CD8+ T细胞或NK细胞释放穿孔素/颗粒酶裂解靶细胞
Cytotoxic_Killing_Lysis.en_description: Effector lymphocyte killing target cell via perforin/granzyme pathway.

Immunosuppressive_Inhibition.name: 微环境抑制 / 免疫耐受诱导
Immunosuppressive_Inhibition.label: 微环境抑制 / 免疫耐受诱导
Immunosuppressive_Inhibition.description: Treg、MDSC或免疫抑制性代谢物对效应细胞活力的压制
Immunosuppressive_Inhibition.en_description: Suppression of effector immunity by regulatory cells or immunosuppressive metabolites.

Chemotactic_Recruitment_Infiltration.name: 趋化招募 / 组织浸润
Chemotactic_Recruitment_Infiltration.label: 趋化招募 / 组织浸润
Chemotactic_Recruitment_Infiltration.description: 趋化因子浓度梯度诱导特异性白细胞迁移并浸润至微环境
Chemotactic_Recruitment_Infiltration.en_description: Chemokine gradient directing leukocyte migration and tumor infiltration.

Antigen_Presentation_Priming.name: 抗原呈递 / 免疫初筛激活
Antigen_Presentation_Priming.label: 抗原呈递 / 免疫初筛激活
Antigen_Presentation_Priming.description: 树突状细胞通过MHC分子向初始T细胞呈递肿瘤抗原肽
Antigen_Presentation_Priming.en_description: Dendritic cell presents tumor antigenic peptides via MHC to naive T cells.

Stroma_Remodeling_Angiogenesis.name: 基质重塑 / 异常血管生成
Stroma_Remodeling_Angiogenesis.label: 基质重塑 / 异常血管生成
Stroma_Remodeling_Angiogenesis.description: CAF分泌细胞外基质或VEGF促进肿瘤异常血管新生
Stroma_Remodeling_Angiogenesis.en_description: Fibroblast ECM remodeling or angiogenic factor release promoting vascularization.
